sections.title: Open events
sections.sql: select code,mode,owner,status from recalls where status='open' order by code

sections.title: Outstanding stock
sections.sql: select recall,lot,destination,unit,distributed,unaccounted from recovery_balance where status='open' order by recall,lot,destination

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from record_checks order by recall,rule

sections.title: Lot identity
sections.sql: select lot,product,supplier,date_mark from lot_balance order by lot

sections.title: Lot balances
sections.sql: select lot,unit,quantity,held,samples,distributed,undistributed from lot_balance order by lot

sections.title: Distribution contacts
sections.sql: select recall,destination,business,contact,phone,address from distribution_contacts order by recall,lot,destination

sections.title: Unacknowledged
sections.sql: select recall,lot,destination,owner,response_due from recovery_balance where not acknowledged and status='open' order by response_due,recall
